name: radio-group
useFor: Use RadioGroup for one choice from two to five visible options (what happens when an agent finishes). Wrap each RadioGroupItem with its text in a Label. For a short segmented switch use ToggleGroup or Tabs; for a long list use Select.
constraints: A radio that grows or bounces when chosen
source: The Hoplite website's hexagon bullets (.pr-features svg, .bp-list__mark: a regular hexagon in a 1px --line stroke) and the principles (a radio is a hexagon that fills)

title: Radio group
description: One choice from a list: each radio a point-up hexagon outlined in the strong line, like the site's hexagon bullets; chosen, it fills with the ink around a small hexagon of the ground.
